summary: This House Resolution supports the goals of Red Ribbon Week, encouraging people to wear red ribbons, light up buildings, and participate in drug prevention activities from October 23 through October 31, 2025, to promote drug-free communities and lifestyles.

scores.thoughts: This resolution is entirely focused on supporting Red Ribbon Week, which is a drug use prevention campaign. It emphasizes reducing demand for illicit substances, promoting drug-free lifestyles, and commemorating efforts against drug trafficking. This directly aligns with stricter drug enforcement through prevention and awareness.
